notes: Security detection is non-discriminating: both configurations found all planted security issues and flagged none of the 8 safe decoys.
The skill's gains come from architecture findings (2/2 vs 0/2), per-finding file:line (1/2 vs 0/2 cases fully compliant), and code fixes for every Critical/High (2/2 vs 0/2).
With-skill reports are ~40% shorter (13-15 findings vs 22-25) at equal recall; line citations were 100% accurate in all four reports.
Cost: +12% tokens, +26% wall time, mostly from running detect_stack.py and the verification pass.
Only failure with skill: a grouped Low finding listed locations as 'several' — SKILL.md now requires grouped findings to list every file:line.
1 run per configuration: treat deltas as indicative, not statistically significant.
